objective: Keyboard-centric Textual TUI for viewing JSON/JSONL logs with follow mode, filtering, and detail view.

tasks.title: Define core data models
tasks.details: Create LogEntry, FilterState, SearchHistoryEntry with full typing and keyword-only args. Write unit tests alongside.

tasks.title: Implement JSON/JSONL parser
tasks.details: Load file, detect JSON vs JSONL, parse safely, collect invalid lines as skipped. Include parser tests.

tasks.title: Create file watcher for follow mode
tasks.details: Track file offset, append new lines, batch UI updates, handle rotation. Support --follow CLI flag. Include watcher tests.

tasks.title: Build base Textual app shell
tasks.details: App class, screens wiring, Ctrl-only keybindings, Catppuccin Mocha theme CSS, CLI argument parsing for --follow.

tasks.title: Implement main log list widget
tasks.details: Scrollable list with level colors, selection, and keyboard navigation. Include UI tests.

tasks.title: Implement detail view widget
tasks.details: Formatted JSON view with navigation between entries. Include UI tests.

tasks.title: Implement query parser and filter engine
tasks.details: Parse field:value tokens, AND/OR operators, negation, quoted values, numeric compare, and apply filters. Include filter tests.

tasks.title: Add search bar with history
tasks.details: Input widget, history dropdown, persistence, navigation through history. Include tests.

tasks.title: Add level filter bar
tasks.details: Toggle buttons, counts, keyboard shortcuts 1-5/0. Include tests.

tasks.title: Add clipboard copy functionality
tasks.details: Copy formatted JSON or raw log line with success toast. Include tests.

tasks.title: Integrate follow mode behavior
tasks.details: Auto-scroll when following; pause on manual scroll. Toggle via Ctrl+T. Include UI tests.

tasks.title: Add GitHub Actions CI
tasks.details: Create GitHub Actions workflow for running pytest and Textual tests on push/PR.
